LanguageData.OARK_Letter_UnlockedFile:
While assisting in research at the Oberonia Aurea Orchid Orchid's science division, your colonist {0} unexpectedly discovered a special unlocked document lying on a nearby research cabinet.

The document was quietly placed there, neither locked nor concealed, as if easily within reach.

Most members of the science division are currently resting, and there is no one else around. You can choose to formally request permission to satisfy your curiosity or take advantage of the absence of others to privately browse the document.

After all, given the kind nature of the science division members, even if discovered, it wouldn’t be a big deal.

Right...?
LanguageData.OARK_UnlockedFile_LoveLetterRefuse:
After {0} asked the document's owner for permission to browse it, {0} clearly noticed that in that brief moment, the owner's expression cycled through at least four distinct emotions—panic, shyness, unease, and a faint hint of smugness. After finally rebooting their brain and hurriedly putting away the document, they politely declined your request, explaining it away with phrases like "personal matters" or "unimportant things."

It seems this document holds significant importance to them...

Regardless, attempting to sneak a peek now would be much more difficult.
LanguageData.OARK_UnlockedFile_EncryptedFileRefuse:
After {0} asked the document's owner for permission to browse it, they didn’t outright refuse but agreed after a brief moment of thought.

However, when {0} handed the document back, the owner fell silent for a while before delivering unfortunate news:

“This is an encrypted file, but... I can’t remember the password...”
Before {0} could respond, they added,
“Let’s focus on our research for now. That’s more important than a single file.”

{0} couldn’t discern their true intentions, but it was clear they were once again engrossed in their research. Relying on them seems impossible now.

Regardless, attempting to sneak a peek now would be much more difficult.

LanguageData.OARK_UnlockedFile_Detection: However, the moment {0} began browsing the document, the owner returned to the lab and caught {0} red-handed.\n\nUpon realizing their personal file had been accessed without permission, the researcher was visibly displeased—not so much due to potential data or privacy leaks but because {0} had deceived them, betraying their trust.
LanguageData.OARK_UnlockedFile_TechDesign:
As {0} carefully yet eagerly picked up the document, they realized they’d stumbled upon something valuable.

As suspected, the document turned out to be a detailed research log from a science officer, recording the entire process of a technological breakthrough from conception to completion, including all critical data points.

The manuscript was so thorough that it could even be used to replicate the invention directly, saving us a tremendous amount of time.

LanguageData.OARK_UnlockedFile_LoveLetter:
As {0} carefully yet eagerly picked up the document, they realized they might have intruded upon someone’s privacy.

From any angle, this was undeniably a personal document. Every line overflowed with the owner’s budding, naive affection, while the end was littered with crossed-out confessions they hadn’t yet mustered the courage to voice.

Though it held no practical value, witnessing such pure love lifted {0}’s spirits slightly.

Regardless, such heartfelt emotions are always enviable.
